title: Distributed Sparse Tensor Computations in MLIR
problem: Lack of compiler support for distributed sparse tensor computations
motivation: MLIR enables compiler optimization for tensor computations
method: They created a new MLIR dialect—a custom language within the MLIR compiler framework—specifically for distributed sparse tensor computations. Sparse tensors are arrays containing mostly zeros, and this dialect lets the compiler handle operations on these tensors efficiently across multiple machines. This fills a gap where compiler support for distributed sparse tensor operations was previously missing.
key_novelty: An MLIR dialect that enables compiler support for distributed sparse tensor computations.
contributions: MLIR dialect enabling Graph Attention Network compilation
